Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D pixel-art animation sprite sheet, aura FX ONLY. Create a restrained BLACK ASH aura emitting slowly upward for a dark fantasy cursed sword. All wisps and flakes stay safely inside their own cells with at least 15% empty padding, no cross-cell bleed. True RGBA TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND including the space between cells. No opaque background, checkerboard, floor, shadow, words, numerals, border, character, sword, weapon, person, props or UI. This is an aura overlay to repeat very subtly ALONG a sword in-game; DO NOT draw the sword. Keep every cell's plume scale consistent, animate only upward ash drift and dissipation.
